svg.title: J6 Clinic file edit: checked save and reset

g.text: J6 Clinic file edit: checked save and reset
[a needed part is missing or empty, or the file is over 100,000 characters]
Needed: clinic name, address, phone and emergency phone;
hours; at least one doctor; at least one service with a
price; policies. Anything else in the file is kept as it is.
